about: Figures behind the opinion essay ai-unemployment-basic-income (Tao Lin's forecast of near-universal unemployment, why means-tested public assistance would not scale, and a small basic income now). Costs of a basic income in Japan come from data/japan-2026.json and AI profits from data/ai-profits-2026.json; build.js checks that every language of the essay carries the digits listed under 'digits' for each fact here, and the costs recomputed from data/japan-2026.json.
